description: Frontend Evolution - turn the desktop app into a real Dictionary Pro learning workspace with reusable API and UI foundations

userStories.title: Create frontend API client boundary
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a shared frontend API client so that renderer pages call local SPARK APIs through one maintained boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a shared API client module under apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/
Client exposes typed functions for GET /api/health and POST /api/dict/lookup
Client has one configurable API base URL with http://localhost:4173 as the local default
Client returns structured success and error objects; pages must not parse raw fetch responses directly
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Extract shared workspace UI primitives
userStories.description: As a developer, I want reusable workspace UI primitives so future pages can share consistent input, action, status, and result layout patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Add shared components for status message, action button state, and result section layout
Components do not include Dictionary-specific business wording unless passed as props
No card-inside-card layout is introduced
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add Dictionary workspace state model
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Dictionary Pro page state to be explicit so that the UI can manage input, request status, results, and errors predictably.
acceptanceCriteria: Dictionary page state includes input text, loading state, error message, backend status, and last result
Empty input cannot trigger a lookup
Starting a lookup clears stale errors
Failed lookup preserves the user's input
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add backend availability feedback
userStories.description: As a learner, I want the desktop app to show whether the local SPARK backend is reachable so that I know why lookups may fail.
acceptanceCriteria: Dictionary page checks GET /api/health when the page opens or when the user manually refreshes status
Backend status is shown as reachable, unavailable, or checking
If backend is unavailable, Dictionary lookup controls remain visible and submit shows a clear local-backend error path
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Wire Dictionary Pro page to local API
userStories.description: As a learner, I want to enter an informal expression and get Dictionary Pro output in the desktop app so that I can use the app as a real study workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: Dictionary page has a primary input for an expression such as a big deal
Dictionary page has a visible action button that triggers POST /api/dict/lookup through the shared API client
While the request is running, the page shows a non-blocking loading state
Successful response renders at least original expression, academic alternative, register notes, and examples when available from the API response
Failed response shows a concise error message without clearing the input
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
